risk_summary: The company reports severely constrained liquidity, only approximately $115,000 in cash and $164,000 available under an insider line of credit, with management stating that funding supports only limited activity for twelve months. Its operating plan and planned $5 million investment depend entirely on new financing, despite no ongoing funding arrangements and prior unsuccessful efforts. Significant debt obligations, reliance on related-party financing, and substantial execution and development requirements create a pronounced going-concern risk.
